description: At night the Plaza del Castillo glows warm at the heart of Pamplona's old town — the arcaded buildings around the square lit, the belle époque façade of Café Iruña where Hemingway lingered, the plane trees and street lamps casting pools of light across the stones. Travellers note the square's evening light as one of its charms. Beyond it, the old city of Navarrería keeps its medieval quarters, and the citadel walls stand dark.
